structures.title: Salary structures
structures.subtitle: How a monthly gross splits into basic, HRA and allowances, and which deductions apply — and who is on which structure.
structures.name: नाम
structures.hint: Basic and the allowances are worked out from each person’s monthly gross; “Balance of the gross” takes what is left. PF, ESI, PT, LWF and TDS follow Statutory rules.

staff.emptyHint: Add staff in Staff & HR, with their salary, then put them on a structure.

runs.title: Payroll runs
runs.subtitle: One run a month: calculate it from staff attendance, check it, approve it, then record the bank transfer.
runs.forHint: One run a month for the whole institution, or one per campus.
runs.draftHint: The run starts as a draft. Calculating it reads the month’s staff attendance — loss of pay, half days, unpaid leave — and works out every payslip.
runs.verifyWarning: The statutory rules (PF, ESI, professional tax, LWF, income tax) are the shipped defaults and haven’t been checked yet. Verify them in Statutory rules before paying real salaries.
runs.emptyHint: Put staff on salary structures first, then start this month’s run.
runs.approveHint: {{count}} staff, net ₹{{net}}. After approval the payslips can’t change, and the bank files can be made.
runs.paid: Payment recorded — staff can see their payslips.
runs.payHint: Loan instalments are booked against the loans now, once. Staff are told their payslip is ready.
runs.sodHint: You prepared this run, so someone else approves it (Statutory rules › separation of duties).
runs.exceptions_one: {{count}} person isn’t paid in this run
runs.exceptions_other: {{count}} people aren’t paid in this run
runs.notCalculated: Calculate the run to see the payslips.

stat.slabsHint: From a monthly gross of ₹ · tax a month ₹ · in February ₹ (optional)
